<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Lola's Galaxy Arcade</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fredoka:wght@400;600&display=swap">
<style>
:root{--bg:#07102a;--sea:#0b3a73;--sky:#7fd4ff;--gold:#ffd98a;--card:rgba(255,255,255,.09);--line:rgba(127,212,255,.35);--tx:#eaf6ff;color-scheme:dark;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
*{box-sizing:border-box;touch-action:manipulation;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
body{margin:0;min-height:100vh;color:var(--tx);font:16px/1.4 'Fredoka',system-ui,sans-serif;background:radial-gradient(1.5px 1.5px at 12% 18%,#fff,transparent),radial-gradient(1px 1px at 78% 10%,#fff,transparent),radial-gradient(2px 2px at 88% 40%,#cfeaff,transparent),radial-gradient(1px 1px at 30% 60%,#fff,transparent),radial-gradient(1.5px 1.5px at 55% 85%,#fff,transparent),linear-gradient(#07102a,#0b2a5b 55%,#0e5a8f);background-color:#07102a;background-attachment:fixed}
main{max-width:720px;margin:auto;padding:20px 14px 40px}
h1{margin:0;font-size:2rem;text-align:center;color:var(--sky);text-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(127,212,255,.6)}
.sub{text-align:center;opacity:.8;margin:4px 0 14px}
.bar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:10px 14px;margin-bottom:10px}
.bar b{color:var(--gold)}
.meter{height:10px;border-radius:9px;background:#0005;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:14px}
.meter i{display:block;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--sky),var(--gold));transition:width .5s}
.free{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#1b6fb5,#6a4fc9);border-radius:16px;padding:12px;text-align:center;margin-bottom:14px}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(140px,1fr));gap:10px}
.tile{font:inherit;color:inherit;text-align:left;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;cursor:pointer}
.tile .e{font-size:1.8rem}
.tile small{opacity:.75}
.tile.play{border-color:var(--sky);box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(127,212,255,.25)}
.tile.done{background:rgba(255,217,138,.14);border-color:var(--gold)}
.tile.soon,.tile.wait{opacity:.45;cursor:default}
.tile:focus-visible,.btn:focus-visible,.cell:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--gold)}
#ov{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#07102a;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)) 12px calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))}
#ov[hidden]{display:none}
#box{width:100%;height:100%;overflow:auto;background:linear-gradient(#0b2a5b,#0a1f45);padding:16px;text-align:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}#ga{width:100%;max-width:440px;margin:auto}#gt{display:none}
#box h2{margin:.2em 0}
.btn{font:inherit;color:#07102a;background:var(--sky);border:0;border-radius:14px;padding:10px 18px;margin:6px 3px;cursor:pointer}
.big{font-size:2rem;padding:40px 30px;border-radius:24px}
.cell{font:inherit;font-size:2rem;color:inherit;aspect-ratio:1;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;cursor:pointer}
.g3,.g4{display:grid;gap:8px;max-width:300px;margin:auto}
.g3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}.g4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
.row{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:10px}.row .cell{width:80px}
.big2{font-size:2.2rem;margin:.3em 0}
input{font:inherit;font-size:16px;padding:10px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--sky);background:#0006;color:inherit;text-align:center;width:80%;margin:6px 0}
#sky{position:relative;height:300px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:16px;background:#0004}
.star{position:absolute;top:-40px;font-size:2rem;background:none;border:0;animation:fall 3s linear forwards}
@keyframes fall{to{top:300px}}
  .tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:6px}.tab{font:inherit;color:inherit;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);cursor:pointer}.tab.on{background:var(--sky);color:#07102a}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.meter i{transition:none}}
</style></head>
<body><main>
<h1>🦦 Lola's Galaxy Arcade ✨</h1>
<p class="sub">50 games. Play each one once, finish them all, then play forever.</p>
<div class="bar"><span>Rank: <b id="rk"></b></span><span>Tokens: <b id="tk"></b></span></div>
<div class="meter"><i id="mt"></i></div>
<div class="tabs" id="tb"></div><p class="sub" id="pn"></p><div id="fr"></div>
<div class="grid" id="bd"></div>
</main>
<div id="ov" hidden><div id="box"><h2 id="gt"></h2><div id="ga"></div></div></div>
<script>
if(location.hash=='#reset'){try{localStorage.removeItem('lola50')}catch(e){}location.hash=''}
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s),R=(a,b)=>a+Math.floor(Math.random()*(b-a+1)),sh=a=>a.map(x=>[Math.random(),x]).sort((p,q)=>p[0]-q[0]).map(x=>x[1]);
const N="Memory Sequence Race|True or False Blitz|Trivia Derby|Guess the Emoji|Four Pics One Word|Lola Word Search|Word Scramble|Hangman|Wordle-style|Word Chain|Otter Match|Star Sequence|Spot the Difference|Memory Grid|Who Moved?|Whack-an-Otter|Catch the Falling Stars|Tap Speed Test|Penalty Shootout|Bubble Pop|Sliding Tiles|Otter Maze|Galaxy Jigsaw|Galaxy Tetris|Ocean Mini Golf|Sushi Snake|Ping Pong|Pac-Otter|Flappy Stingray|Table Soccer|Tic-Tac-Toe|Connect Four|Rock Paper Scissors|Ocean Battleship|UNO|Spin the Wheel|Scratch Cards|Dice Duel|Bowling|Sushi Slots|Draw Your Favourite Animal|Paint by Number|Sushi Builder|Pixel Art Challenge|Lola's Lakeside Village|Piano Tiles|Karaoke Sing-Along|Basketball Shootout|Color Bounce|Final Boss Quiz".split('|');
const E="🏁 ✅ 🏇 🤔 🖼️ 🔍 🔤 🪢 🟩 🔗 🦦 ⭐ 👀 🧠 🔀 🔨 🌠 ⚡ ⚽ 🫧 🧩 🌀 🌌 🟦 ⛳ 🍣 🏓 🟡 🐟 🥅 ⭕ 🔴 ✊ 🚢 🃏 🎡 🎟️ 🎲 🎳 🎰 🐾 🎨 🍱 👾 🏘️ 🎹 🎤 🏀 🔵 👑".split(' ');
let S;try{S=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('lola50'))}catch(e){}
S=S||{done:{},ord:null};
if(!S.ord)S.ord=sh([...Array(50).keys()].map(i=>i+1));
const save=()=>{try{localStorage.setItem('lola50',JSON.stringify(S))}catch(e){}};
let pg=0;const PN=['Page 1: Trivia & Words','Page 2: Memory & Reflex','Page 3: Puzzles & Arcade','Page 4: Board & Luck','Page 5: Creative & Music'];const G={},WAIT=[50];
const tokens=()=>Object.values(S.done).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);
const ready=()=>Object.keys(G);
const isFree=()=>ready().every(k=>S.done[k]!=null);

/* shared text-answer engine */
const tx=(e,end,I,t)=>{I=sh(I).slice(0,8);let i=0,s=0;const nx=()=>{if(i==I.length)return end(Math.round(s*100/I.length));e.innerHTML=`<p>${i+1}/${I.length} · ${t}</p><h2 class="big2">${I[i][0]}</h2><input id="in" autocomplete="off"><br><button class="btn" id="ok">Go</button><button class="btn" id="sk">Skip</button>`;const go=k=>{if(!k&&$('#in').value.trim().toUpperCase()==I[i][1])s++;i++;nx()};$('#ok').onclick=()=>go(0);$('#sk').onclick=()=>go(1)};nx()};
const scr=w=>{let z;do z=sh([...w]).join('');while(z==w);return[z,w]};
G[7]=(e,end)=>tx(e,end,['OTTER','GALAXY','COFFEE','SUSHI','OCEAN','PAINT','STARS','PLANET'].map(scr),'Unscramble it');
G[5]=(e,end)=>tx(e,end,[['🦦 🪨 🌊 🐚','OTTER'],['🍣 🥢 🍚 🐟','SUSHI'],['☕ 🖤 🫘 ⏰','COFFEE'],['🌠 ⭐ 🌌 🔭','UNIVERSE'],['🩵 ☁️ 🕊️ 🪁','SKY'],['💌 🌹 🎁 💞','ROMANCE'],['🎨 🖌️ 🖼️ 🌈','PAINTING'],['🎤 🎶 🎧 🎵','SINGING'],['🌊 🏖️ 🐚 🌅','OCEAN'],['🏆 🥇 🔥 💪','WINNER']],'Four pics, one word');

G[2]=(e,end)=>{const Q=sh([['Otters hold hands while they sleep.',1],['The Sun is a planet.',0],['Octopuses have three hearts.',1],['Venus is the closest planet to the Sun.',0],['Stingrays are related to sharks.',1],['A galaxy is bigger than a solar system.',1],['Coffee beans are seeds of a fruit.',1],['The Pacific is the largest ocean.',1],['Mars is called the Blue Planet.',0],['Sushi rice is seasoned with vinegar.',1]]);let i=0,s=0;const nx=()=>{if(i==Q.length)return end(s*10);e.innerHTML=`<p>${i+1}/10</p><h3>${Q[i][0]}</h3><div class="row"><button class="btn" id="t">True</button><button class="btn" id="f">False</button></div>`;[['t',1],['f',0]].forEach(([k,v])=>$('#'+k).onclick=()=>{if(v==Q[i][1])s++;i++;nx()})};nx()};

G[11]=(e,end)=>{const c=sh(['🦦','🍣','☕','🌊','🐟','⭐'].flatMap(x=>[x,x]));let o=[],m=0,f=0,lock=0;e.innerHTML='<p id="hud">Moves: 0</p><div class="g4" id="gr"></div>';const gr=$('#gr');c.forEach(x=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='cell';b.textContent='❔';b.onclick=()=>{if(lock||b.dataset.u)return;b.textContent=x;b.dataset.u=1;o.push(b);if(o.length==2){m++;$('#hud').textContent='Moves: '+m;lock=1;const[a,d]=o;if(a.textContent==d.textContent){f++;o=[];lock=0;if(f==6)setTimeout(()=>end(Math.max(20,100-(m-6)*10)),500)}else setTimeout(()=>{a.textContent=d.textContent='❔';delete a.dataset.u;delete d.dataset.u;o=[];lock=0},700)}};gr.append(b)})};

G[16]=(e,end)=>{let s=0,t=20,m=-1;e.innerHTML='<p id="hud"></p><div class="g3" id="gr"></div>';const gr=$('#gr'),hud=$('#hud');const draw=()=>{[...gr.children].forEach((b,i)=>b.textContent=i==m?'🦦':'');hud.textContent=`⏱ ${t}s  ⭐ ${s}`};for(let i=0;i<9;i++){const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='cell';b.onclick=()=>{if(i==m){s++;m=-1;draw()}};gr.append(b)}const mv=setInterval(()=>{m=R(0,8);draw()},750),tm=setInterval(()=>{t--;draw();if(t<=0){clearInterval(mv);clearInterval(tm);end(Math.min(100,s*7))}},1000);draw()};

G[17]=(e,end,em)=>{let s=0,t=20;e.innerHTML='<p id="hud"></p><div id="sky"></div>';const sk=$('#sky'),hud=$('#hud');const up=()=>hud.textContent=`⏱ ${t}s  ⭐ ${s}`;const sp=setInterval(()=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='star';b.textContent=em||'⭐';b.style.left=R(2,85)+'%';b.style.animationDuration=R(20,35)/10+'s';b.onclick=()=>{s++;b.remove();up()};b.onanimationend=()=>b.remove();sk.append(b)},600);const tm=setInterval(()=>{t--;up();if(t<=0){clearInterval(sp);clearInterval(tm);end(Math.min(100,s*8))}},1000);up()};

G[18]=(e,end)=>{let n=0,t=10,on=0;e.innerHTML='<p id="hud">Press START, then tap as fast as you can!</p><button class="btn big" id="tp">START</button>';const b=$('#tp'),h=$('#hud');b.onclick=()=>{if(!on){on=1;b.textContent='TAP!';const tm=setInterval(()=>{t--;h.textContent=`⏱ ${t}s  👆 ${n}`;if(t<=0){clearInterval(tm);b.disabled=true;end(Math.min(100,n*2))}},1000)}else{n++;h.textContent=`⏱ ${t}s  👆 ${n}`}}};

G[19]=(e,end)=>{let n=0,g=0;e.innerHTML='<p id="hud"></p><p>Pick where to shoot!</p><div class="row" id="bt"></div>';const h=$('#hud');const up=m=>h.textContent=`${m||'Shot 1 of 5'}  ⚽ ${g}`;up();['⬅️','⬆️','➡️'].forEach((x,i)=>{const k=document.createElement('button');k.className='cell';k.textContent=x;k.onclick=()=>{const d=R(0,2);n++;const nx=Math.min(n+1,5);if(d==i)up(`🧤 Saved! Shot ${nx} of 5`);else{g++;up(`GOAL! 🎉 Shot ${nx} of 5`)}if(n==5){$('#bt').innerHTML='';end(g*20)}};$('#bt').append(k)})};

G[31]=(e,end)=>{let B=Array(9).fill(''),over=0;const L=[[0,1,2],[3,4,5],[6,7,8],[0,3,6],[1,4,7],[2,5,8],[0,4,8],[2,4,6]];const W=p=>L.some(l=>l.every(i=>B[i]==p));e.innerHTML='<p>You are ⭐ · CPU is 🌙</p><div class="g3" id="gr"></div>';const gr=$('#gr');const dr=()=>[...gr.children].forEach((b,i)=>b.textContent=B[i]);const fin=()=>{if(W('⭐')){over=1;end(100)}else if(W('🌙')){over=1;end(20)}else if(B.every(x=>x)){over=1;end(60)}return over};const cpu=()=>{const f=p=>{for(const l of L){const v=l.map(i=>B[i]);if(v.filter(x=>x==p).length==2&&v.includes(''))return l[v.indexOf('')]}};let m=f('🌙');if(m==null)m=f('⭐');if(m==null&&!B[4])m=4;if(m==null){const a=B.map((x,i)=>x?-1:i).filter(i=>i>=0);m=a[R(0,a.length-1)]}B[m]='🌙';dr();fin()};for(let i=0;i<9;i++){const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='cell';b.onclick=()=>{if(B[i]||over)return;B[i]='⭐';dr();if(!fin())setTimeout(cpu,300)};gr.append(b)}};

G[33]=(e,end)=>{let a=0,b=0;const O=['✊','✋','✌️'];e.innerHTML='<p id="hud"></p><div class="row" id="bt"></div>';const h=$('#hud'),bt=$('#bt');const up=(m='First to 3 wins!')=>h.textContent=`${m}  You ${a} – ${b} CPU`;up();O.forEach((x,i)=>{const k=document.createElement('button');k.className='cell';k.textContent=x;k.onclick=()=>{const c=R(0,2);if(c==i)up(`Draw ${O[c]}`);else if((i+1)%3==c){b++;up(`CPU ${O[c]} wins`)}else{a++;up(`You win vs ${O[c]}`)}if(a==3||b==3){bt.innerHTML='';end(a==3?100:40)}};bt.append(k)})};

G[3]=(e,end)=>{const Q=sh([['Largest planet?',['Jupiter','Mars','Venus'],0],['Closest star to Earth?',['Sirius','The Sun','Polaris'],1],['Which animal holds hands while sleeping?',['Otter','Sloth','Goat'],0],['Where does sushi come from?',['Italy','Japan','Brazil'],1],['Largest ocean?',['Atlantic','Indian','Pacific'],2],['Our galaxy is called…',['Andromeda','Milky Way','Orion'],1],['Coffee comes from…',['Beans','Leaves','Roots'],0],['How many hearts does an octopus have?',['One','Three','Eight'],1]]);let i=0,y=0,c=0;const nx=()=>{if(i==Q.length)return end(Math.round(y*100/Q.length),y>c?'You beat the CPU! 🏆':y==c?'Tie with the CPU!':'The CPU won this race.');const q=Q[i];e.innerHTML=`<p>Q${i+1}/${Q.length} · You ${y} – ${c} CPU</p><h3>${q[0]}</h3>`;q[1].forEach((o,k)=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='btn';b.style.display='block';b.style.margin='8px auto';b.textContent=o;b.onclick=()=>{if(k==q[2])y++;if(Math.random()<.65)c++;i++;nx()};e.append(b)})};nx()};
G[4]=(e,end)=>tx(e,end,[['🍕','PIZZA'],['🐘','ELEPHANT'],['🚀','ROCKET'],['🌋','VOLCANO'],['🎸','GUITAR'],['🏰','CASTLE'],['🦋','BUTTERFLY'],['🐬','DOLPHIN']],'Guess the emoji');
G[8]=(e,end)=>{const w=sh(['SPACE','COFFEE','DOLPHIN','PAINTING','UNIVERSE','LANTERN'])[0];let g=[],l=6;const up=()=>{e.innerHTML=`<h2 class="big2">${[...w].map(c=>g.includes(c)?c:'_').join(' ')}</h2><p>❤️ ${l}</p><div id="kb"></div>`;'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'.split('').forEach(c=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='btn';b.style.cssText='padding:8px 10px;margin:2px';b.textContent=c;b.disabled=g.includes(c);b.onclick=()=>{g.push(c);if(!w.includes(c))l--;if([...w].every(x=>g.includes(x)))return end(40+l*10);if(!l)return end(20,'It was '+w);up()};$('#kb').append(b)})};up()};
G[9]=(e,end)=>{const w=sh(['OCEAN','STARS','OTTER','SUSHI','PAINT','LIGHT','MUSIC','DREAM'])[0];let rows=[],n=0;const up=()=>{e.innerHTML=`<p>Guess the 5-letter word (${6-n} tries left)</p><div class="big2">${rows.join('<br>')}</div><input id="in" maxlength="5" autocomplete="off"><br><button class="btn" id="ok">Guess</button>`;$('#ok').onclick=()=>{const v=$('#in').value.toUpperCase();if(v.length!=5)return;n++;rows.push([...v].map((c,i)=>c==w[i]?'🟩':w.includes(c)?'🟨':'⬛').join('')+' '+v);if(v==w)return end(Math.max(25,100-(n-1)*15));if(n==6)return end(20,'It was '+w);up()}};up()};
G[12]=(e,end)=>{const P=['⭐','🌙','☀️','🪐'];let q=[],i=0,lv=0,lock=1;e.innerHTML='<p id="hud"></p><div class="g3" id="gr" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)"></div>';const h=$('#hud'),bs=[];const fl=k=>{bs[k].style.opacity=1;setTimeout(()=>bs[k].style.opacity=.5,300)};P.forEach((x,k)=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='cell';b.textContent=x;b.style.opacity=.5;b.onclick=()=>{if(lock)return;fl(k);if(q[i]!=k)return end(lv*12);i++;if(i==q.length){lv++;if(lv==8)return end(100);setTimeout(nx,600)}};bs.push(b);$('#gr').append(b)});const nx=()=>{q.push(R(0,3));i=0;lock=1;h.textContent=`Round ${lv+1} of 8 · watch…`;q.forEach((k,j)=>setTimeout(()=>fl(k),700*(j+1)));setTimeout(()=>{lock=0;h.textContent='Your turn!'},700*q.length+500)};nx()};
G[14]=(e,end)=>{let rd=0,pts=0;const nx=()=>{if(rd==3)return end(Math.min(100,pts*34));const n=rd+3,t=sh([...Array(9).keys()]).slice(0,n);let sel=[],lk=1;e.innerHTML=`<p>Round ${rd+1}/3 · memorize ${n} tiles</p><div class="g3" id="gr"></div>`;const bs=[];for(let i=0;i<9;i++){const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='cell';b.style.background=t.includes(i)?'#7fd4ff':'';b.onclick=()=>{if(lk||b.dataset.s)return;b.dataset.s=1;sel.push(i);b.style.background=t.includes(i)?'#7fd4ff':'#c0392b';if(sel.length==n){if(sel.every(x=>t.includes(x)))pts++;rd++;setTimeout(nx,800)}};bs.push(b);$('#gr').append(b)}setTimeout(()=>{lk=0;bs.forEach(b=>b.style.background='')},1800)};nx()};
G[20]=(e,end)=>G[17](e,end,'🫧');

G[6]=(e,end)=>{const Wd=['OTTER','SUSHI','OCEAN','STARS','COFFEE'],n=8;let g=Array.from({length:n},()=>Array(n).fill(''));Wd.forEach(w=>{for(let t=0;t<200;t++){const h=R(0,1),r=R(0,h?n-1:n-w.length),c=R(0,h?n-w.length:n-1);const cs=[...w].map((_,i)=>h?[r,c+i]:[r+i,c]);if(cs.every(([y,x],i)=>!g[y][x]||g[y][x]==w[i])){cs.forEach(([y,x],i)=>g[y][x]=w[i]);break}}});const A='ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ';g=g.map(r=>r.map(x=>x||A[R(0,25)]));let f=[],p=null,t=90;e.innerHTML='<p id="hud"></p><div id="gr" style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(8,1fr);gap:3px"></div>';const hud=$('#hud'),gr=$('#gr'),cells={};const up=()=>hud.textContent=`⏱ ${t}s · Find: ${Wd.filter(w=>!f.includes(w)).join(' ')||'all done!'}`;g.forEach((r,y)=>r.forEach((l,x)=>{const k=document.createElement('button');k.className='cell';k.style.cssText='font-size:1.1rem;border-radius:8px';k.textContent=l;cells[y+','+x]=k;k.onclick=()=>{if(!p){p=[y,x];k.style.background='#ffd98a88';return}const[y0,x0]=p;p=null;const o=cells[y0+','+x0];if(!o.dataset.f)o.style.background='';if(y0!=y&&x0!=x)return;const L=Math.max(Math.abs(y-y0),Math.abs(x-x0))+1,dy=Math.sign(y-y0),dx=Math.sign(x-x0),cs=[...Array(L).keys()].map(i=>[y0+dy*i,x0+dx*i]),q=cs.map(([a,c])=>g[a][c]).join(''),w=Wd.find(m=>m==q||m==[...q].reverse().join(''));if(w&&!f.includes(w)){f.push(w);cs.forEach(([a,c])=>{const z=cells[a+','+c];z.dataset.f=1;z.style.background='#7fd4ff88'});up();if(f.length==Wd.length){clearInterval(tm);end(100)}}};gr.append(k)}));const tm=setInterval(()=>{t--;up();if(t<=0){clearInterval(tm);end(f.length*20,f.length+' of 5 found')}},1000);up()};

a1=a+PI/4+k*PI/2,a2=a1+PI/2;c.strokeStyle=CO[s[k]];c.beginPath();c.moveTo(150+h*Math.cos(a1),oy-cam+h*Math.sin(a1));c.lineTo(150+h*Math.cos(a2),oy-cam+h*Math.sin(a2));c.stroke()}};cv.onpointerdown=()=>{st=1;vy=-6.2};const tm=setInterval(()=>{t++;if(st){vy+=.28;by+=vy}if(by-cam<230)cam=by-230;ob.forEach(o=>{if(go||o.p)return;if(hit(o))go=1;else if(by<o.y-95){o.p=1;sc++;let n;do n=R(0,3);while(n==bc);bc=n}});c.clearRect(0,0,300,420);ob.forEach(o=>{const a=t*.028*o.w;if(o.y-cam<-120||o.y-cam>540)return;switch(o.ty){case 0:dRing(o.y,70,a,o.sh);break;case 1:dBar(o.y,t*2.2*o.w,o.sh);break;case 2:dArm(o.y,a,o.sh);break;case 3:dRing(o.y,78,a,o.sh);dRing(o.y,52,-a*1.3,o.s2);break;case 4:dSq(o.y,a*.8,o.sh);break;default:dBar(o.y,t*2.4*o.w,o.sh);dBar(o.y-38,-t*2.8*o.w,o.s2)}});c.save();c.shadowColor=CO[bc];c.shadowBlur=14;c.fillStyle=CO[bc];c.beginPath();c.arc(150,by-cam,8,0,7);c.fill();c.restore();$('#hud').textContent=st?`Tap to bounce! Pass only your color · ${sc} / ${NN}`:'Tap to start bouncing!';if(sc>=NN||go||by-cam>440){clearInterval(tm);end(sc>=NN?100:Math.round(sc*100/NN),sc+' of '+NN+' obstacles')}},16)};

/* shell */
const rank=t=>t<250?'Rookie Otter':t<500?'Star Swimmer':t<800?'Sea Captain':'Galaxy Champion';
function draw(){const d=ready().filter(k=>S.done[k]!=null).length,r=ready().length,f=isFree();$('#rk').textContent=rank(tokens());$('#tk').textContent=tokens();$('#tb').innerHTML=PN.map((t,i)=>`<button class="tab${i==pg?' on':''}" onclick="pg=${i};draw()">${i+1}</button>`).join('');$('#pn').textContent=PN[pg];$('#mt').style.width=d/r*100+'%';
$('#fr').innerHTML=f?'<div class="free">🎊 Every ready game is complete! Free play is open: replay anything to beat your best.</div>':`<p class="sub">${d} of ${r} ready games complete · 50 planned</p>`;
$('#bd').innerHTML='';S.ord.filter(id=>Math.ceil(id/10)-1==pg).forEach(id=>{const b=document.createElement('button');const dn=S.done[id]!=null;let c='tile',st;if(WAIT.includes(id)){c+=' wait';st="Waiting for Lola's answers"}else if(!G[id]){c+=' soon';st='Coming soon'}else if(dn){c+=' done';st=f?`Best ${S.done[id]} · replay`:`✓ Done · ${S.done[id]}`}else{c+=' play';st='Play'}b.className=c;b.innerHTML=`<span class="e">${E[id-1]}</span><b>${N[id-1]}</b><small>${st}</small>`;b.onclick=()=>play(id);$('#bd').append(b)})}
function play(id){if(!G[id])return;const f=isFree();if(S.done[id]!=null&&!f)return;const ov=$('#ov'),a=$('#ga');ov.hidden=false;$('#gt').textContent=N[id-1];a.innerHTML='';G[id](a,(sc,m)=>{S.done[id]=Math.max(S.done[id]||0,sc);save();a.innerHTML=`<h2>${sc>=80?'🏆':sc>=50?'🎉':'👏'} ${sc} / 100</h2><p>${m||''} Best: ${S.done[id]}</p><button class="btn" id="bk">Back to board</button>`;$('#bk').onclick=()=>{ov.hidden=true;draw()}})}
save();draw();
</script></body></html>
